items.proposed: no candidate; candidate_exclusion_reason excluded_intervention_type (agreed coding stands)
items.reason: Sargramostim is given with every vaccine dose and 'works to stimulate the immune system to help the SurVaxM/Montanide ISA 51 work more effectively'; it has no own arm or own outcome, so under R4 it is part of the excluded vaccine therapy.

items.proposed: no candidate; sargramostim and Montanide ISA 51 role excluded_intervention_type (not supportive)
items.reason: R4 names GM-CSF/sargramostim and Montanide explicitly as part of the excluded therapy when given to support a vaccine; the record's primary objective is the toxicity of 'SurVaxM in emulsion with Montanide plus sargramostim', i.e. the vaccine regimen, not sargramostim as an antitumour agent.

H3 K27M is required only for atypical pontine lesions in the DIPG stratum ('histologic confirmation of diffuse glioma WHO Grade II-IV with H3 K27M mutation'); GBM patients enter the relapsed HGG strata without it, so it is not selection for this trial.

note: Excluded at S6 (excluded_intervention_type). Mixed age (1-21 years, CHILD+ADULT). Survivin IHC >=1% required for relapsed strata (vaccine target, not candidate-matched). treatment_setting 'both' because a newly diagnosed DIPG stratum sits beside relapsed strata (GBM patients are relapsed/progressive only). any_molecular_selection stays true because survivin IHC >=1% is still required for relapsed HGG (incl. GBM) patients. The exclusion of H3 K27M-altered DMG outside the pons is exempt under D31-A5.
